block_users.description: Block WhatsApp users from messaging your business number. WhatsApp only lets you block someone who messaged you in the last 24 hours; any it refuses are listed with the reason.
block_users.name: block_users

parameters.description: The phone numbers to block, with country code, up to 1000.
parameters.name: users

parameters.description: Which of your business numbers to use. Leave empty to use the one saved on the connection.
parameters.name: phone_number_id

create_message_template.description: Submit a UTILITY or MARKETING message template for Meta's review. Placeholders are written {{1}}, {{2}} or {{first_name}} in the text, with one example value each. Review usually finishes within minutes and can take up to 24 hours; until then the template is PENDING and cannot be sent.
create_message_template.name: create_message_template

parameters.description: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores; spaces become underscores.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: UTILITY for updates about something the customer did (orders, bookings); MARKETING for promotions.
parameters.name: category

parameters.description: The message text, up to 1024 characters, such as 'Hi {{1}}, your order {{2}} has shipped.'
parameters.name: body_text

parameters.description: One example value per placeholder in the body, in the order they first appear. Meta's reviewers read these.
parameters.name: body_examples

parameters.description: Such as en_US, en or es. Defaults to en_US.
parameters.name: language_code

parameters.description: Optional bold header line, up to 60 characters.
parameters.name: header_text

parameters.description: An example value if the header has a placeholder.
parameters.name: header_example

parameters.description: Optional small grey footer, up to 60 characters.
parameters.name: footer_text

parameters.description: Up to 10 button labels, each up to 25 characters.
parameters.name: quick_reply_buttons

delete_message_template.description: Delete a message template. Without a template ID every language of that name is deleted. The name of a deleted approved template cannot be reused for 30 days, and a disabled template cannot be deleted.
delete_message_template.name: delete_message_template

parameters.description: The name of the template to delete.
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.description: Optionally, the id of one language version, to delete only that one.
parameters.name: template_id
